title: In-game Trainer 0.4.0-beta.4 / 游戏内修改器
body:
## Installation guide updated / 安装指南已更新

Download **FFWTrainer-0.4.0-beta.4-installation-update.zip** for the same mod with the expanded bilingual guide. [English installation guide](https://github.com/ohhhhhhhhha/far-far-west-desktop-trainer/blob/main/INSTALL.en.md) · [中文安装指南](https://github.com/ohhhhhhhhha/far-far-west-desktop-trainer/blob/main/INSTALL.zh-CN.md). It distinguishes the game root from the executable folder and explains UE4SS verification, updates and startup troubleshooting. The mod runtime files are unchanged.

请下载 **FFWTrainer-0.4.0-beta.4-installation-update.zip**，内含同一版本 Mod 和完善的双语指南。指南说明 UE4SS 与修改器的不同安装目录、先验证框架、旧版更新和启动故障排查。游戏 Mod 文件未改变。

Choose **Drop on ground** or **Gain directly** under Settings. F3 uses the selected mode without new key bindings. The direct mode uses the game's native Joker acquisition event.

This update improves local-controller mouse routing, input recovery and menu handoff. Ground spawning pauses when 10 uncollected dropped Jokers are within 20 metres. F1/F2/F4 and existing progression features remain available.

**Tested UE4SS:** [v3.0.1-1181-g83330635, official experimental archive](https://github.com/UE4SS-RE/RE-UE4SS/releases/download/experimental/UE4SS_v3.0.1-1181-g83330635.zip). Install UE4SS separately; close the game, copy the contents of GameRoot into the game directory, keep Data/settings.json, then restart.

在设置中选择生成到地面或直接获得，F3 按所选模式执行，不新增按键。改进鼠标输入恢复与切图交接；周围 20 米内已有 10 张未拾取掉落卡时暂停地面生成。

已验证的框架：[UE4SS v3.0.1-1181-g83330635 官方下载](https://github.com/UE4SS-RE/RE-UE4SS/releases/download/experimental/UE4SS_v3.0.1-1181-g83330635.zip)。另行安装后，退出游戏，复制运行包 GameRoot 内的内容，保留 Data/settings.json，再重启。

The user confirmed initial beta.4 mouse navigation and both Joker modes; 34 offline test files and additional navigation tests passed. Follow-up handoff cases were tested offline. The original reporters' crashes have not been independently reproduced. The packages contain no personal data, saves or logs.
